items: How do my guests join?
Host with an account. Guests join free in their browser using a link or six-digit room code.
How do speaking turns work?
The person holding the talking stick speaks while everyone else listens. Choose clockwise or counterclockwise turns, or an open round where the group chooses who speaks next.
How do I prepare a circle?
Name your room, choose a speaking order, and set an optional turn timer. Prepare a shared center, then send your invitation link.
How is our conversation handled?

Video and audio are encrypted in transit and relayed live through Cloudflare's realtime network. The host chooses when recording starts. Saved recordings are automatically deleted after a period of time to reduce server costs. You can delete them sooner.
How many people can I invite?
Free includes up to six people, Starter eight, and Basic or Pro twelve. These limits include you as host. Contact us about Studio.
How long can we meet?

Free circles last up to 30 minutes each. Starter, Basic and Pro allow circles of any length within your monthly participant-hours. Participant-hours add up the time each person spends in all your circles.
How do I cancel my plan?
Cancel anytime. Your plan continues until the end of the period you paid for. Export any recordings you want to keep before your plan ends.
Can I use my own branding?
Your room carries your circle's name. Custom logos and visual identity are in preparation. Talk to us about what your practice or program needs.

final.intro: Bring your people into a circle. Give each voice time, listen deeply, and discover what takes shape between you.

items: How do my guests join?
Host with an account. Guests join free in their browser using a link or six-digit room code.
How do we choose when AI participates?
Begin in Human Mode, then invite Milo or live translation when your group wants to use them. The room shows which features are active.
How is our conversation handled?

Video and audio are encrypted in transit and relayed live through Cloudflare's realtime network. You choose when recording starts. Saved recordings are automatically deleted after a period of time to reduce server costs. You can delete them sooner. An invited AI feature processes the audio it needs while active.
How does Milo take part?
Milo joins by voice and listens to the conversation in real time. It speaks on its turn, or when its name is called in an open round. You can invite it to join or ask it to leave during the circle.
What does beta mean for live translation?

You can use live translation today with credits. Quality varies by language pair, and availability may change as we improve it. You pay for active minutes. If we pause translation, your circle continues in the original voices.
How do we listen across languages?

Each person chooses their listening language. They hear a translated voice with the original softly present underneath. Translation uses 2 credits per listener per active minute and is currently in beta.
What happens when our credits run out?
Your circle continues in Human Mode. Milo leaves and translation pauses while your group keeps talking. You choose whether to purchase more credits.
Can I use my own branding?
Your room carries your circle's name. Custom logos and visual identity are in preparation. Talk to us about what your practice or program needs.
